name: Planner Sticker Set
descriptionOriginal: Three 8 x 6 in sheets of illustrated planner stickers: florals, fruit, small animals and everyday objects, plus a few short text labels.
whyWeLikeIt: Illustrated stickers add colour and detail with no painting. Rifle says each of its designs starts as an original gouache painting by Anna Bond.
limitations: These are printed planner stickers, not found paper, and a few are short text labels such as Birthday and To-do, so they sit best beside your own scraps.
qualityNote: No sentiment line recorded by Cowork. Reviewers on Rifle's page call the stickers adorable with a nice assortment of images.
specsEvidence: Rifle Paper Co., https://riflepaperco.com/products/planner-sticker-set (read 2026-11-20): page text shows no sheet count, sticker count or motif list in the content we could read; the general brand statement is that each design starts with an original gouache painting by Anna Bond. Counts of 128, 130 and 150 appear elsewhere, so none is used here.
suitability: Illustrated stickers for adding one decorative accent to a spread; contents unconfirmed.
